_doc: Tales for the Fairytales shelf, read by tools/import_fairytales.py. ws: Wikisource page titles to try (first that exists wins; else a search on 'search'). img: Wikimedia Commons searches for public-domain illustrations, best first (Bilibin's 1899-1902 tales are public domain). n: how many pictures to set through the tale.

tales.title: Василиса Прекрасная
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: A merchant's daughter, sent by her stepmother to borrow a light from Baba Yaga, survives the witch's tasks with the help of a little doll from her dead mother.

tales.title: Царевна-лягушка
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Ivan Tsarevich's arrow lands by a frog, whom he must marry; she is a princess under a spell, and when he burns her frog skin too soon he must travel to the end of the world to win her back.

tales.title: Пёрышко Финиста Ясна Сокола
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: The youngest daughter asks her father only for a falcon's feather; it brings her a falcon-prince, and when her sisters drive him away she wears out iron shoes to find him.

tales.title: Марья Моревна
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Ivan Tsarevich marries a warrior queen, then frees the chained Koschei the Deathless from her cellar, and must win a horse from Baba Yaga to bring her back.

tales.title: Белая уточка
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: While the prince is away, a witch turns his young wife into a white duck; her children, hatched as ducklings, are found out by their father.

tales.title: Сестрица Алёнушка и братец Иванушка
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Little Ivanushka drinks from a hoof-print and becomes a kid goat; his sister Alyonushka marries a merchant, until a witch drowns her in the river.

tales.title: Сказка об Иване-царевиче, жар-птице и о сером волке
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Sent to catch the firebird that steals his father's golden apples, Ivan Tsarevich is helped by a grey wolf through a chain of quests: a horse with a golden mane, and Elena the Beautiful.

tales.title: Морозко
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: A stepmother sends her stepdaughter to freeze in the winter forest; Grandfather Frost rewards the girl's patience, and her stepsister fares otherwise.

tales.title: Колобок
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: A round loaf rolls away from the old couple who baked it and sings its way past a hare, a wolf and a bear, until it meets the fox.

tales.title: Репка
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Grandfather cannot pull up the giant turnip alone; grandmother, granddaughter, dog and cat join in, and in the end it takes the mouse.

tales.title: Теремок
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: A fly, a mouse, a frog, a hare, a fox and a wolf move one by one into a little house in a field, until the bear arrives.

tales.title: Гуси-лебеди
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Geese-swans carry off a little boy to Baba Yaga; his sister chases after them, helped by a stove, an apple tree and a river of milk.

tales.title: По щучьему веленью
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Lazy Emelya catches a magic pike and lets it go; from then on, 'by the pike's command', buckets walk home, sledges drive themselves and a tsar's daughter falls in love.

tales.title: Сивка-бурка
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Ivan the Fool keeps watch at his father's grave and is given a magic horse, on which he leaps to the tower window of the tsar's daughter.

tales.title: Кощей Бессмертный
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: Koschei the Deathless carries off a prince's bride; his death is hidden in a needle, in an egg, in a duck, in a hare, in a chest under an oak.

tales.title: Снегурочка
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: A childless old couple make a girl out of snow, and she comes to life; but when summer comes and she jumps over the bonfire, she melts away.

tales.title: Крошечка-Хаврошечка
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: An orphan worked to the bone by her foster family is helped by a cow, who does her tasks for her — until One-Eye, Two-Eyes and Three-Eyes spy on them.

tales.title: Лиса и журавль
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
img: Fox and crane Russian tale illustration
tales.blurb: The fox serves the crane porridge on a flat plate; the crane returns the favour with soup in a tall jug.

tales.title: Журавль и цапля
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: A crane and a heron take turns proposing to each other across the marsh, and neither can ever say yes at the right moment.

tales.title: Курочка Ряба
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: The speckled hen lays a golden egg that the old couple cannot break; a mouse knocks it off the table with her tail.

tales.title: Лисичка-сестричка и волк
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: The fox steals fish off a peasant's sledge and then talks the wolf into fishing with his tail through the ice.

tales.title: Каша из топора
tales.author: Афанасьев А.Н.
tales.blurb: A soldier on his way home tells a stingy old woman he can make porridge out of an axe — and bit by bit gets everything else out of her.
